name: hash-retrieve
description: Keyword-grade document retrieval: embeds the query and each document as a hashed bag-of-words vector (32-bit FNV-1a) and ranks documents by cosine similarity, returning the top k. Zero cost, fully offline, deterministic, no model or network call. This is NOT semantic search — it has no notion of meaning, synonyms, or word order, so it will miss paraphrases and can be fooled by superficial vocabulary overlap. Use it for a cheap 'find documents that share words with this query' pass over a small local set, not as a substitute for embedding-model retrieval.

k.description: Number of top hits to return. Defaults to 5.

index.description: Index into the original documents array.

score.description: Cosine similarity, in [-1, 1] (typically [0, 1] for bag-of-words vectors).
